shortDescription: Manage storage pool information on VSP block storage systems.

options.name: connection_info
options.description: Information required to establish a connection to the storage system.

options.name: state
options.description: The level of the storage pool task. Choices are C(present), C(absent), C(restore), C(tier_relocate), C(monitor_performance), C(init_capacity_saving). In the case you need to execute C(restore) pool, you need the operation when the pool is blocked due to Shared memory volatilization.

options.name: storage_system_info
options.description: Information about the storage system. This field is an optional field.
